name: tdd
description: Two-phase vertical-slice TDD: locks public seams and vertical test-first slices during planning, then drives red-green-refactor execution with hermetic offline testing boundaries. Prevents implementation-coupled mocks, tautological assertions, and horizontal test slicing.
suggestedPrompts: Design the public test seams and vertical TDD slices for this implementation plan
Implement this milestone using vertical-slice TDD against the planned seams
Audit these tests for implementation-coupled mocks or tautological assertions
